book.name: 2Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Phawuloosanne Wordo Hawaareta
Ta guuththa eeyateththaa intte dandayana mala ta hidota ooththoyssa hayyana dandayte.
Issi gelontta geeshsha geela7oya ba geela7oteththan issi azinas giigiza mala tanikka inttena Kirstoosas giigsida gishshas ta intte gishshas lo7o qofa qoppays.
Shooshshay ba genera Hewaano baleththidayssaththo oonee erizay intte qofaykka moorettiin Kirstoosas diza suurenne geesh gidida ammaneteththaa inttena aggaagandettoo gaada ta hirgays.

Issi asi intteko yiidi nu kase inttes sabbakidayssa gidontta hara Yesusa sabbakikko woykko kase intte ekkida Ayanaa gidontta hara ayana ekkiko woykko kase intte ekkida Mishiraachcho qaalaa gidontta hara Mishiraachcho qaalaa ekkiko coo mela intte xoonettideta guussa.
Gidikkoka tani hayta gita Hawaaretappe aykkonka guuxxizaa taas misatenna.
Haasayan cincca gidontta aggikokka taas eray paccibeenna; hessa nuni inttes dumma dumma ogera qonccen erisidos.
Tani inttes Xoossa Mishiraachcho qaalaa damozay baynda sabbakidaynne inttena dhoqqu histtanaas tani tana kawushshidayssi oonee erizay taas nagara gidi qoodettideesha?
Inttes ooththanaas hankko Woosa Keeththatappe tani maado ekkidayssi isttafe shiishsha ekkadakko.

Tani inttenara dishin tana metiin Maqidooniyappe yida ishati taas koshshizaazan tana maaddida gishshas oonaska tooho gidabeekke; hanno gakkanaaska ay miishshankka inttes tooho gidabeekke; sinththafekka ta inttes tooho gidikke.
Kirstoosa tumateththi tanan diza gishshas tani ceeqettontta mala tana diggizay Akaya deren oonikka baa.
Hessas gaasoykka aazee? Tani inttena siiqontta gishee? Ta inttena siiqizayssa Xoossi erees.
Heyti wordo Hawaareti, «Nunikka isttaththo ooththoos» gishe istti ceeqettizayssa digganaas ta ha7i ooththizayssaththo sinththafekka ooththana.
Heytantta mala asati Kirstoosa Hawaareta misatanaas barkka bana laammiza wordanchcha Hawaaretanne baleththiza oosanchchata.
Hessika daro malalisizaaz gidenna; Xala7eykka bana poo7o kiitanchcha misatissidi laammeettes.
Hessa gishshas heyti Xala7e oosanchchati hankko xillo oosanchchata misatanaas barkka banateththaa laammiko aykkoka malalisenna; wurseththan istti ba ooso waaga ekkana.
Phawuloosi Hawaareteththa Gaason Be7ida Waaye
Oonaska tani eeya gididaaz misatoppo gaada qasseka yootadis; ta isttas eeya misatikkoka guuththa wodes ta ceeqettana mala tana intte eeya mala qoodite.
Tani hessaththo doona kunththa haasayzay Godaa shene mala gidontta eeya asa mala gidadakko.
Daroti ba asho qofaan ceeqettizayssaththo tanikka ceeqettana.
Intte qasse yuushshi qoppizayta gidida mala hankko eeyata ufayssanaas dandayeeta.
Hessaththoka oonikka inttena baas ayllesikkonne oonikka inttena bonqqiko, oonikka inttenan go7ettiko, oonikka inttena leqqiko, oonikka inttes shagalan baqqiko intte dandayeeta.

Izi tana yeellasizaaz gidikkoka hayta ha hanota ooththanaas nuni mino gidonttayssa tani inttes qonccisays. Gido attiin oonikka ceeqettanaas xalikko tanikka izaththo xalada ceeqettana; tani hessa gizay ha7ikka eeya gidadakko.
Heytantti istti Ibraawe asatee? Tanikka Ibraawekko! Istti Isra7eele asatee? Tanikka Isra7eele asakko! Istti Abrahaame zereththatee? Tanikka Abrahaame zereththiko!

Heytantti Kirstoosa oosanchchatee? Tani qasse isttafe bollara Kirstoosas ooththizaade; ta hessaththo gizay gooshsha mala gidadakko! Tani isttafe daro wode ooson daaburadis; daro wode qashettadis; daro wode garafettadis; daro wode hayqos gakkadis.
Ichchashuto heedzdzu tammanne uddufun xurqafe Ayhudatan garafettadis.
Heedzdzuto durqqan bukettadis; issito shuchchan cadettadis; heedzdzuto markabe giddon ta bolla metoy gakkides; issi omarsinne issi gallas abba giddon gam7adis.

Ta hemeta daro gaason haaththa kixaynne di7oy, pangatappe metoy tana gakkides; ta qommo Ayhuda asaappenne Ayzaabetappe waayeynne metoy tana gakkides; katamankka, bazzonkka abba bollankka tana metoy gakkides; hessaththoka wordo ammanizaytappe metoy tana gakkides.
Daro ooththa daaburadis; daro wode dhiskabeekke; gafaninne haaththa saamon waayettadis; daro wode miza kaththi taas dhaydes; meegoynne kalloteththi tana gakkides.
Tani hara miish qoppontta, gallas gallas tana qofsizay Woosa Keeththata ubbaa gishshas qoppiza qofa.
Issi asi daaburshin tani izara daaburontta ayde aggadinaa? Issi asi nagaran kundishin ta qasse iza hanqettontta ayde aadhdha erazinaa?
Ceeqettanaas koshshizaaz gidikko ta ceeqettanay ta daaburanchcha gididayssa tana bessiza miishshan ceeqettays.
Mernaas galatettida Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Aawaa Xoossi ta wordotonttayssa erees.
Tani Damasqo kataman dishin kawo Arsixosiyosappe garsara dere ayssizayssi tana oykkanaas koyidi he katamaa pengeta zabetan naagissides.
Gidikkoka asay tana keeshen yeggidi he katamaa gimbe maskootera duge woththi yeddiin kessa ekka attadis.
